WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.gbsize / s.spanmin AS rate,
    si.riskeval
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    riskeval,
    AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS bench_rate
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ga.avg_rate) AS avg_rate,
  AVG(ga.avg_rate) - b.bench_rate AS margin_above_benchmark
FROM group_averages ga
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE ga.avg_rate > b.bench_rate;
